sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive on the back of a WIN and have been imperious throughout the season with seven victories in their last six outings. Alsager Town are struggling near the foot of the table and have won only once in their last six matches, making this an opportunity for Sandbach to consolidate their position.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could have title implications depending on Sandbach's result; Stafford have picked up recent draws and sit just two points behind the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in a clash between two upper-table sides — Eccleshall have recently suffered a loss but remain in fifth place with a strong record overall. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) face Wednesfield Community at home, with Casuals on a recent win and favourites to extend their winning run. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter, while Barnton at home to Shawbury United offers Barnton a chance to build on their recent win — Shawbury have lost five of their last six and remain in real difficulty near the bottom. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a clash between teams in the lower-mid section, both seeking consistency. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath as both teams look to climb away from their respective problems in the bottom half. Brereton Social host Widnes Town; Widnes are in dire straits with just two points from seven games, while Brereton have some recent positive form and should be favoured. Finally, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a battle between two of the division's weakest performers this season.
